<color><icon SpriteName=EmojiFifthWorldAwkward id=0 width=1 height=1></color> I'm actually kind of embarrassed posting this today since Planarcadia has not tasted destruction yet. Feels a bit like popping champagne at halftime. But no matter, I'm mainly here to discuss some things with all of you here.
<color><icon SpriteName=EmojiFifthWorldLightbulb01 id=1 width=1 height=1></color> What I want to say to you is that Destruction is actually quite easy. The cornerstone of Destruction is not rage or hatred — just a little bit of joyfulness will do.
<color><icon SpriteName=EmojiFifthWorldShocked01 id=2 width=1 height=1></color> You all know about the Destruction of Darennar, right?
<color><icon SpriteName=EmojiFifthWorldSweat id=3 width=1 height=1></color> Back when I was a professor at the Darennar National Institute of Political Science and Economics, there was this young guy (I forget if his name was Pear or Pineapple) who asked me: "Professor, young people nowadays are generally politically apathetic. They feel that state affairs are incredibly dull and boring. How do we boost their political participation?"
<color><icon SpriteName=EmojiFifthWorldLightbulb01 id=4 width=1 height=1></color> I answered: "Politics is a boring topic, but variety shows are fun! Have you ever thought about maybe making politics more entertaining? For example, we could create a show called 'Councilor Dash' and use solid ratings and audience popularity votes to replace those polls and ballots that get tampered with. Wouldn't that boost participation? Plus, it would also reduce election fraud."
<color><icon SpriteName=EmojiFifthWorldShocked02 id=5 width=1 height=1></color> Twenty years later, this young guy, the student I am proudest of, became the planet's head of state. Fifty years or so later, Darennar society had almost completely collapsed.
<color><icon SpriteName=EmojiFifthWorldBreak id=6 width=1 height=1></color> Then, less than five years after that, the civilization has exited the stage of history entirely.
<color><icon SpriteName=EmojiFifthWorldAwkward id=7 width=1 height=1></color> If you ask me, I really don't think I am to blame for that.
<color><icon SpriteName=EmojiFifthWorldSweat id=8 width=1 height=1></color> Got sidetracked a bit. But you'll excuse me, I'm dead after all.
